Reference / config/value

config/value#

One setting read from a SettingReading, with its source.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let port = ScalarSetting(origin: settings, key: SettingKey("server", "port")).text();
let host = ScalarSettingOr(origin: settings, key: SettingKey("server", "host"), fallback: "localhost").text();

Description#

One setting read from a SettingReading, with its source.

A scalar setting has exactly one value; NonScalarSetting says how many it had.
